selected_reviews.title: Annotation geometry and written appearances follow the tables' words
selected_reviews.verdict: retain for the bounded line and text-markup geometry decisions
selected_reviews.basis: Table 178 places line leader endpoints at /L when /LL exists, and Tables 178/179 define line end styles; Table 182 supplies four-vertex quadrilateral geometry and text-edge orientation. Current exact-xref tests use independent endpoint, orientation and trapezoid controls.
selected_reviews.caveat: The stale explanatory header in line_ending_endpoint_spec_audit.rs says ADR 0192 chooses displaced leader endpoints; the test body and implementation test the current table reading. Update prose if this test is promoted.

selected_reviews.title: A press defaults to invert and a printed sheet shows the normal appearance at its own scale
selected_reviews.verdict: retain for Table 191 highlighting and widget print appearance
selected_reviews.basis: Table 191 says /H defaults to I and non-P modes override a down appearance. Pixel assertions distinguish normal/down appearance and default-I edge behavior; print behavior is purpose-specific.
selected_reviews.caveat: This is a bounded Table 191 review; it does not certify unrelated widget/field behavior or all print scaling rules.

selected_reviews.title: A redaction's /RO is drawn strictly after the removal
selected_reviews.verdict: retain for valid /RO post-removal rendering and source-byte safety
selected_reviews.basis: Table 195 says /RO artwork is drawn after content removal and takes precedence over other overlay entries; implementation validates form resources and rejects source-content reachability. Integration tests check removal and post-removal rendering.

selected_reviews.title: The authoring line's redaction overlay is /OverlayText and /IC
selected_reviews.verdict: retain the current narrowly stated owner-scope departure
selected_reviews.basis: Owner ratifications A834/A842 exclude composed /OverlayText and /IC. This is a product scope decision, not a claim that the standard makes those entries optional when an interactive processor supports redaction. /RO is handled separately.

superseded_or_not_reaffirmed.reason: Do not carry the former /RO withdrawal into current status: valid /RO is now applied after removal; only /OverlayText and /IC remain named as excluded authoring composition.
